items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: When Ben Black got an iron giant and he couldn't talk, and somebody said, what about Johnny D. He'd write. Because I had been a leader all my life. I was just a side man that helped him work out that contract.

ctx.x: He used to lick more people and get drunk. If you fool with him, he'd knock them down. And right here was the same type, about six foot straight old man, did his handball every morning, or played golf with me. He's the handsome man. Now he plays character parts, the most ugly parts. He looks like a big old fat sneaky sheriff or something like that. But he came here not long ago. When he phoned me, he was out on the driving range. He hit some balls after I went out to see him. I said, Ray, you're getting a little…
Well he was a hop hit.
